newsitem.title: UK: Tempest poll of global Emg Mkt funds, broker tables.
newsitem.headline: Tempest poll of global Emg Mkt funds, broker tables.

text.p: The following are the key global rankings from a Reuter-sponsored survey of companies, fund managers and brokers operating in some 27 emerging markets.

The survey was conducted over the past three months by Tempest Consultants and involved contacting over 840 fund managers and buy-side analysts, over 230 national and international brokers and some 1,700 brokers' analysts.
